description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a unique opportunity for a committed nursing leader looking for a stable, permanent role within a supportive environment.As the ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and supporting our dedicated nursing team. You will collaborate closely with the Director of Nursing to implement policies, manage staff, and maintain regulatory compliance, contributing significantly to the well-being of our residents.This position is exclusively for candidates seeking a permanent, full-time commitment. We are looking for a leader who is ready to invest in a long-term career with a facility that values stability and continuous improvement in resident care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably as an ADON or Supervisor
Experience within a skilled nursing facility setting
Demonstrated commitment to a permanent, full-time role
Strong clinical knowledge, communication, and organizational skills
